name: OpenTable API
tagline: Partner API for restaurant search, availability, and reservation booking.
description: OpenTable provides approval-gated APIs for restaurant directory data, availability and booking, reservations, guests, CRM, and operational integrations. Production access requires review and a formal agreement. OAuth 2.0 is the primary authorization mechanism, and the current public documentation is hosted at docs.opentable.com.

auth.details: Partner/program credentials; self-serve public API key signup not confirmed from public docs

pricing.paid_plans: Partner/commercial pricing; public self-serve tiers not published

rate_limits: Online Booking APIs allow at most 1,000 requests across all endpoints per rolling 30-second window (about 33 requests/second sustained); other OpenTable APIs or endpoints may have different limits.
use_cases: search restaurants by location or cuisine
check table availability for a party size and time
create or cancel a restaurant reservation
retrieve restaurant details and booking policies
